---
title: "The Filing Cabinet"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: article
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

Every official action in the simulation happens through one of these
forms. Sign in with the Google account you registered — the system knows
who you are from there: no names to type, no numbers to look up. What you
file appears on the site on the next build (the Wire updates in seconds).

```{r}
#| results: asis
source("scripts/shared.R")
urls <- load_form_urls()

# One "drawer" per role. Links come from the gateway (?view=forms), so
# they are always current — nothing here changes at yearly turnover.
drawer <- function(title, items) {
  have <- items[names(items) %in% names(urls)]
  if (length(have) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))
  cat(sprintf("\n### %s\n\n", title))
  cat(sprintf("- [%s](%s)\n", unname(have), urls[names(have)]), sep = "")
}

if (is.null(urls)) {
  cat("*The cabinet opens when the session begins.*")
} else {
  drawer("Everyone", c(
    Registration = "Register for the simulation",
    Profiles     = "Upload your role profile"
  ))
  drawer("Senators", c(
    Bills = "File a bill — or an amendment to one of yours"
  ))
  drawer("Lobbyists", c(
    Letters  = "File a position letter",
    Spending = "Report a contribution"
  ))
  drawer("Journalists", c(
    Posts    = "Post to the Wire",
    Editions = "Publish a newspaper edition"
  ))
  drawer("Leadership & chairs", c(
    Assignments    = "Committee assignments & leadership",
    Referrals      = "Refer bills to committee",
    `Agenda LGL`   = "File an agenda — Local Government and Labor",
    `Agenda ANR`   = "File an agenda — Agriculture and Natural Resources",
    `Agenda BLH`   = "File an agenda — Business, Law, and Health",
    `Agenda APP`   = "File an agenda — Appropriations",
    `Agenda Floor` = "File an agenda — Senate Floor"
  ))
}
```
